name: Crop to Mask
description: Cut out the part of a picture around a mask, with room around it, and resize it to about a megapixel, so a small region is redrawn at the model's full detail whatever the size of the picture. The box holds every painted pixel, grown by Padding on each side, moved inside the picture where it sticks out. The stitch output remembers where the crop came from: give it to Stitch to put the redrawn crop back.

inputs.name: padding
inputs.label: Padding
inputs.description: Pixels of the picture kept around the mask on each side, so the model sees what surrounds it.

inputs.name: megapixels
inputs.label: Megapixels
inputs.description: The crop is resized to about this many megapixels. 0 keeps its size.

inputs.name: multiple
inputs.label: Multiple of
inputs.description: Each side of the crop is a multiple of this. 16 is the step the diffusion models work in.
